name: The Paper Aisle — Digital Baat Pakki Invitation
description: A mobile-first digital wedding invitation card built on the Paper Aisle studio design: ivory, plum, mauve, and champagne surfaces with elegant Cormorant Garamond typography and SVG-only ornament. The card opens with a tap-to-unlock wax seal, presents the couple's names and families, hides the ceremony date behind a scratch-to-reveal canvas (finger, cursor, or tap), threads a live countdown to the event, and walks guests through a four-moment program timeline, a venue card with a Google-Maps button, a dress-code palette, and three pre-wedding events. Guests RSVP on the spot with a validated form (name, email, attending choice, party size) that rejects duplicates kindly and bumps a persisted confirmed-guest counter, and can export an add-to-my-calendar .ics with a clipboard fallback. Includes a mock music toggle, a closing arch with couple names and date, toast notifications, a bottom RSVP bar, back-to-top, reduced-motion support, and complete data-fws-slot content annotations.
features: mock music toggle with state feedback
scratch-to-reveal ceremony date canvas with finger, cursor, and keyboard reveal
live threading countdown with compact hero ticker
dress-code note with colour palette swatches
three pre-wedding event cards with map links
validated RSVP form with attending choice, party size, duplicates, and reset
persisted confirmed-guest counter with social-proof avatar stack
closing arch with couple names and date · venue
toast notifications, bottom RSVP bar, and back-to-top
fully customizable content via data-fws-slot attributes
